title: Auth preflight accepts legacy User morph during Structure cutover
summary: Cloudron activation can upgrade through the Structure morph-map cutover without failing authorization preflight on databases that still store the previous user class name in triggers.
changes: Treat the previous App\Models\User trigger expression as equivalent to the user morph alias when checking that the authorization compatibility guard is installed.
Keep installing and rewriting triggers to the user alias once migrations run.
Cover the preflight cutover path with a guard regression test.
version_rationale: Patch on v0.37.x: deployment cutover compatibility only, with no change to product behaviour, URLs, or stored permissions after migrate.
validation: php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
Cloudron workflow_dispatch with app_version from VERSION after merge.
known_limitations: After migrate, triggers are rewritten to the user alias; the dual acceptance exists only so preflight can pass before that rewrite.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. No separate database rollback is required for this preflight comparison change.
provenance: Auth preflight morph-alias cutover for issue #299, pull request #301.
